behavior: Up to four inline immutable reports and sixteen exact-payload archive references, with twenty a count upper bound rather than guaranteed capacity.
Prepare hashes and moves the oldest non-current report in a cloned quote; durable objects are inserted only with the consented quote lease CAS in the same D1 batch.

Quote CAS is first; archive/version inserts are guarded by exact new quote payload, owner and version. Inconsistent existing immutable objects force a NOT NULL constraint failure and transaction rollback.

Authorized reads hydrate exact project/delivery/report objects and validate metadata, byte lengths, exact SHA-256, original technical plan and actual uploaded-file digest. Missing, tampered and foreign objects fail closed.
Same-delivery writes retain every prior report and archive reference unchanged. New uploaded delivery clears references; old archived version can retain them.
Quotes/proof_versions and competing-transfer direct writers strip hydrated raw objects. Lightweight version/list projections also strip them.
Acceptance and final model completion append only the inline window, keeping frozen acceptance A bound to its original retained report.
GET model-checks exposes validated complete history and measured capacity; projected report/acceptance bytes use the same budget rules as actual lease admission.
Offline export includes manifest and exact archived payloads, verifies bijection/SHA/identity, and preserves the legacy gate list for envelopes without archive fields.

coverage: Legacy latest-only A; fifth report archival preserving exact A bytes and acceptance.
Twenty reports retained; twenty-first preflight rejection without mutation.
Offline export complete archive and frozen A; omitted/corrupt manifest variants inconsistent.
Replacement clears current references and old snapshot retains A.
Archived version unknown write checkpoint closes once without changing accepted evidence.
Missing original technical agreement disables capacity before any model report exists.
Valid one-MiB raster package plus bounded padded HTTP observations exhausts hydrated capacity below twenty and actual begin rejects consistently.
